headline: Island Clashes Erupt In Fisherman's Row As Central Fronts Shift
war_summary: Since the morning dispatch, immediate base turnover has shifted westward to Fisherman's Row, where four strategic base transfers in the past two hours have turned Dankana Post and Arcadia into active combat zones. Along the central spine, the rapid wave of transitions across the Linn of Mercy has slowed to six exchanges over the past six hours, yet fighting lingers near Fort Duncan and Lathair. To the east, Stlican Shelf has flared into prominence, logging two recent base captures around Thornhold alongside sharply accelerating casualty rates. Stonecradle and Lykos Isle absorbed several mid-day base shifts at The Heir's Knife and Astutia before tactical pacing eased. Meanwhile, attritional meat-grinders in Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse grind on unabated, with Dead Lands registering over five thousand casualties across the past two hours alone while Liberation Point and Abandoned Ward remain heavily contested. Endless Shore and Marban Hollow have consolidated without recent flips, while deep rear sectors across both northern and southern territories remain undisturbed.
